title: Halifax Segway City Spin
includes: All taxes, fees and handling charges
Food and drinks, unless specified (not included)
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Participants must be 16 years or older.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: See and learn about the beautiful and historic sites of Halifax during this guided 2.5-3 hour Segway tour. Your friendly guide will take you by some of Halifax's most popular landmarks, including the Halifax Citadel National Historic Site, Argyle Street, and Grand Parade Square. Choose from the available departure times daily when you book.
